report.explanation: Observed checkout samples are mostly fast (62-78ms) with one 344ms outlier; all responses are 200, 502 count is 0, and traces show successful order/inventory/payment/postgres/redis spans. No error, pool exhaustion, timeout, or memory pressure is evidenced (retained 3-4MB vs 32MB limit). Current facts do not substantiate any taxonomy cause; more evidence is required before naming a root cause.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency/error window for /v1/checkout beyond the single 344ms sample (p95 425ms) to confirm a real degradation vs. cold-start outlier
Dependency-level metrics for gateway->order (simulator_dependency_operations_total returned empty) to localize latency
Downstream service (order/inventory/payment) latency and error metrics to attribute the 344ms checkout
Baseline p95 for /v1/checkout under normal conditions to judge whether 425ms is anomalous
